blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday said it is conducting a fact-finding investigation into the findings of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on an alleged discrepancy in Vice President Sara Duterte’s statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN). “That will undergo fact-finding first. So, it’s a process where we validate the facts that are being presented to us. We need to validate and evaluate them. So, it’s fact-finding,” Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said during a news briefing in Cebu when asked for an update. On Oct. 13, the NBI referred its findings on the alleged […]...
